owner_direction.sample_restart: Restore a previously explicitly chosen offline sample on restart and label it as simulated. Restore layout and accepted indicators. Preserve the selected identity and show the cause when a local source is missing or its authorization has been revoked.
owner_direction.deletion_and_restore: Delete decision-note bodies from live state and keep no transcript by default. Preserve known deletions when restoring backups. Warn before restoring an independent older backup that may bring back a deleted body.
owner_direction.data_uses: Keep authorized local display when another purpose is unknown or forbidden. Trusted Python, cloud models and external clients each require affirmative source entitlement for the specific purpose and explicit user authorization.
owner_direction.platform_sequence: After all locally testable Ubuntu workflows pass, physical Windows experience may proceed with unavailable authorized model or voice sessions recorded separately. Real sessions remain mandatory before the first release.
